observed.caption: A concrete staircase leads up to a colorful market stall displaying patterned dresses, bags, and hats, with paintings leaning on the steps and a sign for the market inspector's office.
observed.description: The photo shows an outdoor market courtyard with a weathered beige concrete staircase with black metal handrails in the center and right, leading to an upper balcony densely packed with colorful merchandise including patterned dresses hanging on the railing, hats, bags, and fabrics displayed on the wall. Three people stand on the balcony near the merchandise, one with their back to the camera wearing a yellow and black checkered shirt and two facing forward in casual clothing. A white sign with black text and an arrow is mounted on the stair wall, and a colorful abstract painting with blue, yellow, orange and green shapes leans against the stairs, with additional paintings of elephants and a portrait on the ground to the left near a closed black accordion security gate and a purple shutter. A blue plastic water bottle sits on the bottom step next to a worn brown wooden board leaning against the wall, with pale yellow building walls enclosing the space.
